Kuvitus: autotalli. Auton takapyörän van: Illustration: a garage. The rear wheel of a car has five wheel nuts. A long cross wrench has been placed on one nut, its handle reaching far to the left, and its end is pressed down by a red force arrow. On the floor to the right of the tyre lies a short spanner.
Ovi ylhäältä katsottuna. Vasemmalla sein: A door seen from above. On the left is a wall and a hinge, from which the door extends to the right as a horizontal board. Three equally long red force arrows: F1 at the handle perpendicular to the door, F2 near the hinge, also perpendicular, and F3 at the end of the door along the door towards the hinge. A dashed arc shows the direction in which the door opens. Schematic figure, not to scale.
Kiintoavain mutterin ympärillä. Mutterin: A spanner around a nut. The axis of rotation O is at the centre of the nut. The handle of the spanner points horizontally to the right, and a hand pulls it at a point at the distance d from the axis. The force F points obliquely up and to the right, at an angle of 60 degrees to the extension of the handle. The line of action of the force is drawn dashed in both directions. The segment drawn from the axis perpendicular to the line of action is the lever arm r of the force, and it is shorter than d. Schematic figure.
Kaksi tilannetta vierekkäin. Kummassakin: Two situations side by side. In both, a horizontal rod is fixed to the axis O at its left end. On the left, the force F acts on the right end of the rod upwards, and the curved arrow around the axis rotates anticlockwise: the moment is positive. On the right, the force acts on the end of the rod downwards, and the curved arrow rotates clockwise: the moment is negative.
Suorakulmainen kolmio, jonka kärjet ovat: A right-angled triangle whose vertices are the axis of rotation O, the point of application of the force and the foot of the perpendicular drawn from the axis to the line of action. The hypotenuse is the distance d between the axis and the point of application. The side from the axis to the foot is the lever arm r of the force. The angle at the point of application is alpha, the same as the angle between the force and the extension of the arm. Therefore r is d times sine alpha.
Ruudukko, jossa yksi ruutu vastaa 0,10 m: A grid in which one square corresponds to 0.10 metres. The axis of rotation O is at the lower left. A slanted rod runs from the axis to the point P, which is four squares to the right and three squares higher than O. At the point P a horizontal force F acts on the rod towards the left. The line of action of the force is drawn dashed.
